project_name: Kharo London Private-Hire Marketplace - Human Design Blueprint
design_philosophy: Anti-AI Human Editorial Design. Replaces predictable AI-template artifacts (omnipresent uppercase eyebrows, cookie-cutter centered card grids, blanket dark green hero overlays, repeated big-stat rows, over-cute copy) with authoritative, asymmetric, London-tailored private hire marketplace editorial design.
user_choices_directives: Remove 'get a real quote from quotezone' completely across VehicleDetail and VehicleCard components.
Remove 'a trusted operator from the area' text/badge on all car listings and card components.
Eliminate AI-esque slop across the entire website and replace key items with professional, human editorial craftsmanship.

typography_system.mono_font: font-mono (Used for numbers, pricing specs, TfL licence numbers)

rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-[1.08] font-bold text-[#1A2E25]
rules.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-[1.15] font-semibold text-[#1A2E25]
rules.eyebrow_elimination_rule: DO NOT put uppercase tracking-widest badges above every heading. Use single-line narrative lead-ins or integrated font-serif kickers embedded naturally in the main heading line.

eyebrow_labels.ai_tell: Repetitive uppercase pill badges like 'PRIVATE HIRE CAR RENTAL, DONE PROPERLY' or 'WHY KHARO' before every heading.
eyebrow_labels.human_replacement: Asymmetrical section kickers, integrated serif italic prefixes (e.g., 'Crafted for London Drivers — *transparent weekly rental without the agency markup*'), or raw clean section headings with generous negative space.

stat_rows.ai_tell: Identical 4-box big-number stat grids repeated on every marketing page.
stat_rows.human_replacement: Human story callouts, integrated fleet ledger snippet, verified operator spotlight note, or structured tabular data with real context.

card_grids.ai_tell: Uniform centered 3-column equal square cards with identical border radii and center-aligned text.
card_grids.human_replacement: Swiss / Mode A Tetris asymmetric layout: 8-column hero vehicle split + 4-column side specs; left-aligned editorial typography; variable height cards with subtle 1px border.

hero_overlays.ai_tell: Heavy full dark-green or black solid overlay obscuring hero vehicle photography.
hero_overlays.human_replacement: Subtle direction gradient (top or bottom vignette max opacity 40%) or unmasked high-contrast photographic cutouts sitting on warm #FBFAF8 bone canvas.

marketing_copy.ai_tell: Generic over-cute fluff like 'Your dream ride awaits' or 'Get a real quote from quotezone'.
marketing_copy.human_replacement: Direct, authoritative London private-hire language: 'TfL-PCO Licensed Fleets', 'EV Congestion Exempt', 'Weekly Rent Includes Maintenance & Servicing', 'Direct Fleet Operator Hire'.

changes: REMOVED: 'a trusted operator from the area' text and badge.
REMOVED: 'get a real quote from quotezone' text/link.
ADDED: Clean spec tags (e.g. 'TfL Ready', 'Hybrid / EV', 'Unlimited Mileage Option').
LAYOUT: Left-aligned, bold weekly price badge (£/wk), clean 1px border `border-[#1A2E25]/10`, subtle shadow on hover, warm card background `#FFFFFF`.
ADDED: Full transparent Weekly Breakdown Ledger (Rent, TfL License status, Servicing included, Deposit terms).
LAYOUT: 2-column editorial breakdown — left wide interactive photo gallery with thumbnail scrub, right floating sticky direct operator deposit & booking card.
Navigation: Crisp text links with subtle dot indicator on active path, prominent 'Browse Fleets' action CTA.
Deep ink background `#1A2E25` with warm bone text `#FBFAF8`.
Editorial publication signature with large brand watermark and clear categorized sitemap links.
Asymmetric Hero: Left bold editorial statement + embedded quick search filter card; Right floating unmasked hero vehicle image.
Spotlight Section: Wide featured vehicle banner with live availability indicator.
City Navigation: Interactive London borough & airport route quick links.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_rule: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, dropdowns, filters) and key informational metrics MUST contain a explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.spacing_scale: Generous editorial spacing: section padding py-16 sm:py-24, gap-8 to gap-12 between asymmetric columns.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.hover_contrast: Ensure explicit hover text contrast on all interactive states (e.g. hover:bg-[#0B6B4F] hover:text-[#FBFAF8]).
